[anthropic-claude-opus-4-6-other-4] Making public-benefit-oriented practices practical ●​ We have developed methods for assessing and improving alignment of models that are now widely used, such as Constitutional AI, the Petri open-source tool, and sparse autoencoders for interpreting AI models.
